name: TroyLabs is a student-run organization at the University of Southern California, proudly sponsored by the Lloyd Greif Center for Entrepreneurship and Marshall School of Business. We're dedicated to fostering entrepreneurship and supporting early-stage startups at USC. Our mission is to encourage innovation, empower student founders, and promote entrepreneurial curiosity across campus, creating a vibrant ecosystem where USC startups can flourish and make a lasting impact.
